files.name: cmd/fanout/herdr_lifecycle.go
files.reason: `fanout herdr` is a user-facing subcommand: the runtime name is the command word operators type, so the file and every identifier in it must spell it. The file is exempt as a whole rather than one identifier at a time.

identifiers.name: Tmux
identifiers.reason: backend.Tmux is a persisted runtime name read back as data (state rows, PaneRef). Branching on it for lane selection is what MutationModel and the capabilities replaced; reading it is not.

identifiers.name: Herdr
identifiers.reason: backend.Herdr is a persisted runtime name read back as data (state rows, PaneRef). Branching on it for lane selection is what MutationModel and the capabilities replaced; reading it is not.

identifiers.name: NewTmux
identifiers.reason: paneruntime.NewTmux is the documented host-runtime constructor. paneruntime is the one package allowed to name a concrete adapter, and a constructor that builds a specific runtime has to say which.

identifiers.name: tmux
identifiers.reason: depNeeds.tmux names the executable the prerequisite probe looks for on PATH, not a launch lane.

identifiers.name: isHerdrLifecycleRequest
identifiers.reason: main.go's dispatch guard for the `fanout herdr` subcommand; it names the allowed command word across the file boundary.

identifiers.name: cmdHerdrLifecycle
identifiers.reason: main.go's dispatch-table entry for the `fanout herdr` subcommand; it names the allowed command word across the file boundary.
